title: When is it enough?
hook: A toy design improves 30% each round. When does it meet its requirement?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Check a growing design against a fixed good-enough threshold at two horizons.

misconception: A design below a customer requirement today will always remain irrelevant.
objective: Check a growing design against a fixed good-enough threshold at two horizons.
